text:
anya (CS Ops): Quick flag  saw ~1.2k accounts in `onboard_in_progress` with no activity for 45+ days. Healthscore for that cohort is drifting down. Can we run a controlled dry-run to validate auto-exit rules?

leo w: Do we currently have an auto-exit? I thought it was gated. Who owns the logic?

maria - onboarding: There's a soft-exit in playbook v2 behind `cs.onboard_auto_exit` feature flag. We saw a few false positives during initial tests. Recommend sampling first.

anya (CS Ops): Proposal: 5k random sample dry-run that only tags `eligible_for_exit` (no state changes). Compute healthscore delta and historical reactivation rate within 14 days. Query for candidate filter attached.

```sql
SELECT account_id, owner, onboarding_stage, last_activity_at
FROM crm.accounts
WHERE onboarding_stage = 'onboard_in_progress'
  AND last_activity_at < now() - interval '45 days'
  AND is_active = true;
```

samira (CS Ops): I can run the 5k dry-run and post diffs (healthscore distribution pre/post, reactivation sim). ETA EOD.

leo w: @playbook-bot schedule job on staging so we can inspect orchestration + logs.

playbook-bot: Scheduled `dryrun_onboard_exit_20260323_12` on staging. Results will be posted to #customer-success-reports.

maria - onboarding: If sample looks good, safe-exit behavior should: set status -> 'stalled', create re-engage task for owner, apply -0.05 healthscore, and a 14-day reactivation window that restores prior state if activity resumes.

anya (CS Ops): Also need an owner-nudge template and a rollback plan (manual restore + audit trail). I'll draft the copy and add to runbook.

leo w: @nate (data-eng) please add telemetry: `onboarding.stale_reactivate_count` and `onboarding.stale_exit_rate` so we can track false positives.

nate (data-eng): Will emit those metrics and add a small Grafana dashboard for the sample job. ETA tomorrow AM.

playbook-bot: Job `dryrun_onboard_exit_20260323_12` completed on staging. Sample: 5,000 accounts -> 3,580 eligible (71.6%). Median healthscore delta: -0.03. Historical-sim reactivation within 14d: 4.1%. Report: https://redwood-reports.internal/cs/dryrun/20260323-12

samira (CS Ops): I'll run a final 1k production-shard sample on a weekday for safety (no state changes). Will attach CSV diff and a manual spot-check list.

anya (CS Ops): Action items: samira run samples + post report; maria prep owner-nudge and task payload; nate add metrics + dashboard; leo coordinate flag flip if artifacts look clean. I'll update runbook stub at /docs/cs/onboard-stale-exit.md.

maria - onboarding: I'll prepare the short owner checklist and confirm messaging.

samira (CS Ops): :thumbsup: scheduling now.

nate (data-eng): Dashboard link when tiles live.

anya (CS Ops): Thanks everyone, will reconvene after the prod sample and final review.
